verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail's own mailbox page claims users can 'set up automation rules and have it handled exactly how you want,' so there is a first-party rule capability. It is backed only by a single marketing line with no documentation of triggers, conditions, or available actions. Zapier and the gated API are external or building-block paths and add no credit. Missing for 10: documented event triggers (e.g., mail received, sender match), documented rule conditions and action types (scan, forward, shred, tag), rule-configuration docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
